title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to join our engineering team and help build polished, performant web experiences for our clients.
responsibilities: Build and maintain responsive, accessible web applications using React and Next.js
Collaborate closely with designers to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect UI
Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code
Mentor junior developers and participate in code reviews
requirements: 4+ years of experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
Strong understanding of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
Experience with state management and API integration
Excellent communication skills

title: UI/UX Designer
description: We are seeking a thoughtful UI/UX Designer who can turn complex problems into simple, elegant, and intuitive designs for web and mobile products.
responsibilities: Conduct user research and translate findings into design decisions
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
Collaborate with developers to ensure design feasibility and quality
Maintain and evolve our design system
requirements: 3+ years of UI/UX design experience, portfolio required
Proficiency in Figma
Strong understanding of accessibility and usability principles
Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms

title: Backend Developer (Spring Boot)
description: We are hiring a Backend Developer experienced with Java and Spring Boot to build secure, scalable APIs that power our client applications.
responsibilities: Design and implement RESTful APIs using Spring Boot
Write database migrations and manage schema design
Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices
Write unit and integration tests
requirements: 3+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot
Solid understanding of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL)
Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
Experience with JWT-based authentication is a plus

title: Digital Marketing Associate
description: We are looking for a creative Digital Marketing Associate to help grow our brand presence across social media, content, and SEO.
responsibilities: Plan and execute social media content calendars
Assist with SEO optimization for our blog and website
Track and report on campaign performance metrics
Collaborate with the design team on marketing assets
requirements: 1-2 years of digital marketing experience
Familiarity with SEO tools and social media platforms
Strong writing skills
A portfolio of past campaigns is a plus

title: QA Engineer
description: We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of the products we ship to clients.
responsibilities: Write and execute manual and automated test cases
Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution
Collaborate with developers to improve testing coverage
Participate in release testing and sign-off
requirements: 2+ years of QA/testing experience
Familiarity with test automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium)
Strong attention to detail
Basic understanding of web and API testing
